what: MOXIR v2 GROUND LAYER: ONLY the lamps on the floor (40 UP-PL5403 + 18 UP-B380F); ids kept from scripts/place/rigs/moxir-v2-spread-2026-10-09.json where a unit just moves
owner: and also other washes and beams what we dont use make on the ground, not on the arcs, and also washs are so close on the ground for now you can use the left places of the area so we need epic thing you know use space right
frame: hall frame: metres, Y up, +x house right, +z toward the entry; rotations three.js Euler XYZ radians, a spot's unrotated beam points -Y; angle_rad = half the beam angle; box solids base-anchored; truss origin at the section centre, tower at the base plate (src/rigbuild/pieces.js), a tower's s[1] scales the 6 m catalogue tower.

rules.par_spacing_why: the structure: the column pitch along a row is 6 m, so at most one PAR per column foot (the joint pair z +-0.5 is one foot), and a 15 deg pool on the space frame at 10.8 m is 2.85 m across, so pools keep a dark gap >= 3.1 m (steel lit in pieces). The scores (this build): the greedy keeps 94.3 % of its objective at 6 m against no rule, 96.7 % at 5 m, 85.1 % at 7 m (par_spacing.curve).

crane_park.why: the near crane + the cut truss move inside it (another workflow, "half behind the DJ"): no unit above 2.5 m there and no beam through it

rules.islands: B's fan (6 heads) in the stage pen + 4 fenced islands x 3 heads, >= 15 m apart, >= 1 in the entry half (z >= 24)
rules.objective: sum over eyes (weighted by the people each stands for) and depth bins of sqrt(light): PAR lx from lit surfaces (Lambertian, one bounce, the crowd not see-through), beam G (single scattering, haze t40)

par_eye_rule.what: every floor PAR: its beam (15 deg + 1 deg aim tolerance, from its 0.10 m lens) between 1.5 and 1.9 m up to its first hit, against every public feet point 0.25 m apart (the stage pen, the machines and every fenced pen out); a person leaning 0.5 m

key.why: the gap between the PA boxes (x -6.5..-2.9), 1.71 m behind the barrier line (z 8.16: out of reach, ISO 13857 1.4 m), behind their front line: the only floor place that sees the DJ past both boxes

booth.why: the far corner of the same gap (beside the PA R box, 1.46 m behind the barrier: out of reach), the longest throw the gap gives to the booth front (2.6 m); its own lamp: from the floor the DJ face and the booth front are 14.7 deg apart, more than one 15 deg PAR holds

PA L.why: the house-left end of the pit, beside the PA L box (x < -10.0), 1.16 m behind the barrier (inside the 1.4 m reach: mesh guard + the pit's security), raking across its face

PA R.why: the house-right end of the pit, beside the PA R box (x > -0.1), 0.56 m behind the barrier (inside the 1.4 m reach: mesh guard + the pit's security); aimed into the face so the whole beam ends on the box before it rises to a leaning eye (searched: a5_par.py, the only pit-end aims that keep every eye out)

pens.method: FIX 2: 0.01 m steps, the lower edge from the lens's lowest point (0.08 m), half beam 0.9 + aim tolerance 2.0 deg, over the whole desk window (pan +-10 deg every 2.5 at the tilt limit); heads >= 1.5 m from their barrier

fan.what: FIX 1a + 4: B's six plane-1 heads exactly as the spread has them (place and aim); every low run over its window inside the fan strip, clear of the smoke machine's refill point and the crew lanes; never into the cut at any park z 0.15-4.25

beam_field_glare.what: every public plan point (painted hot, wings, bar, chill; not the stage pen, a fenced pen or a machine) every 0.5 m, eyes at 1.5/1.7/1.9 m (+0.6 on the FOH riser), every beam over its whole desk window (9 pans x 4 tilts), the angle at the head

rules.why: ASSUMED margins: no B380F ray within 1 m of a laser unit, no B380F end within 3 m of a block
